csv_project_name: AE for On-Call Foothill Transit Full-Service Facilities
csv_scope_of_work: Foothill Transit is issuing this Request for Qualifications No. 26-078 (RFQ) seeking Submittals from qualified individuals or firms to provide full-service facilities architectural and engineering (A&E) services on an on-call, task-order basis. The services are expected to support Foothill Transit s administrative facilities, operations and maintenance facilities, and related site and building improvement construction projects.

title: A&E for On-Call Foothill Transit Full-Service Facilities
short_description: On-call A&E services for transit administrative, operations, maintenance, and site improvement projects.
project_scope: On-call, task-order-based architectural and engineering services for Foothill Transit full-service facilities. The assignment is expected to support administrative facilities, operations and maintenance facilities, and related site and building improvement construction projects. No specific building sizes, gross floor areas, structural spans, or individual project scopes are stated in the notice.
services: Full-service A&E services on an on-call basis, including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, cost estimating, site evaluation/selection, land use planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary A&E framework.
- Covers buildings and facility improvements rather than bridges or long-span special structures.
- It is an on-call framework without defined individual projects, limiting immediate strategic value.
- Transit operations and maintenance facilities may include some technically relevant building tasks, but no complex structural features are described.
- Presence of architecture and engineering services offers potential teaming opportunities, yet the scope appears broad and general.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender notice. The procurement is for on-call task-order-based professional services covering administrative, operations, maintenance, and related site/building improvement projects, but no project volumes, facility sizes, or capital program values are provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is explicitly available. This is an RFQ for on-call A&E services on a task-order basis, so compensation would likely depend on future assignments; no contract ceiling, hourly rates, or estimated workload are stated in the notice.
references_qualifications: Qualified individuals or firms are sought to provide full-service facilities A&E services. Specific minimum reference counts, project types, or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
award_criteria: Not stated in the provided notice.
